rationale: The buyer is real — privacy-conscious tech workers do pay for software — but the product category (browser) is one of the most engineering-intensive in software, requiring a full rendering engine, OS-level integrations, and years of mobile optimization work that no Claude-powered solo factory can approach. Buildability is essentially zero for this context. Even if the pain and willingness-to-pay signals are genuine, there is no viable path to build or deliver this as a micro-service.
solution_plan: This is not buildable by a non-technical solo operator with this factory. A browser requires a Chromium/WebKit fork, a mobile app team, and multi-year engineering investment. No workaround exists — this opportunity should be dropped entirely.
